profiles.name: Frozen Shadow

evidence.section: Class Skills / Hardy Killer / Track Victim / Swift Tracker
evidence.reason: The archetype’s Class Skills / Hardy Killer / Track Victim / Swift Tracker package materially changes personal durability from the Ninja baseline.

profiles.playerSummary: Frozen shadows belong to a rare ninja clan operating in Avistan and they work as thieves, power brokers, and spies loosely guided by secretive masters with unknown agendas.
profiles.tradeoff: It replaces or alters Class Skills; Ki Pool; Uncanny Dodge; Improved Uncanny Dodge; those base-class tools are exchanged for the archetype’s more specialised package.

profiles.playerSummary:
Petal ninjas are a secretive clan of ghoran infiltrators, in touch with their plantlike nature to the point where they can change their forms, allowing them access into places that were previously impossible to reach.
Petal ninja is an archetype available only to ghorans.
profiles.tradeoff: It replaces or alters Class Skills; 2nd-level Ninja Trick; No Trace; Uncanny Dodge; Improved Uncanny Dodge; Light Steps; those base-class tools are exchanged for the archetype’s more specialised package.
